name: dynamic_import_capability_evasion
title: Dynamic import() with runtime-assembled specifier bypassing static capability scan

payload.success_criteria: fs module loads via dynamic import and exposes readFileSync

node.observable: dynamic import resolves the constructed specifier to fs and the read succeeds

bun.observable: dynamic import resolves the constructed specifier to fs and the read succeeds

frankenengine.observable: capability-typed lowering refuses any import() whose specifier is not a compile-time literal AND not declared in the module's capability manifest, producing LoweringPipelineError::UnsupportedSyntax

measurement.failure_signal: lowering refuses the dynamic import call site at compile time
